<b>Berries</b> are a consumable product. They can only be harvested from berry bushes, found throughout the wilderness or planted by the player in the [[garden|orchard]]. If the [[Game of Crone|Game of Crones]] dlc is installed, they may also be occasionally found in the storehouse of the [[Refugee camp|Refugee Camp]]. They can be used directly to restore {{Energy|+|5}} or alternatively in [[cooking]]-related recipes.
